summary: Vale S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing an interest payment on its 10th-issue incentive debentures. The company will pay R$ 207,311,945.43 in remuneratory interest on October 15, 2026, to holders of record at the close on October 14, 2026, across three series totaling 6,000,000 debentures. No board recommendation, advisor, acquisition, divestiture, or structural event is involved. This is an ordinary debt-service notice; no deal terms, no risk-arb angle, and nothing to watch beyond routine credit monitoring.
